desc.ian_image_library:title: Mnemiopsis leidyi (Comb Jelly)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Mnemiopsis leidyi is a species of tentaculate ctenophore originally native to the western Atlantic but is now invasive in the Black, Caspian, North and Baltic Seas
